component.name: OpenWGT
component.summary: An open engine for Maxis' Widget Workshop

description.p: An open engine for Widget Workshop: A Mad Scientist's Laboratory (Maxis, 1995), the gadget-building toy: wire parts together on a worksheet and watch them run, or solve the puzzles.
It comes with its own pictures, sounds, texts and puzzles, in English and Swedish, so it runs without the original CD; with the CD it can use the original's instead.
